mapper.select: SELECT id, product_id, sku_id, product_name AS name, sku_version AS version, sku_color AS color, sku_color_hex AS color_hex, price, quantity, image FROM cart_item WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT p.id AS product_id, p.name AS product_name, s.id AS sku_id, s.version, s.color, s.color_en, s.color_hex, s.price, p.image_subject FROM product_sku s JOIN product p ON p.id = s.product_id WHERE s.id = #{skuId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart_item (session_id, product_id, sku_id, product_name, sku_version, sku_color, sku_color_hex, price, quantity, image) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{productId}, #{skuId}, #{productName}, #{version}, #{color}, #{colorHex}, #{price}, #{quantity}, #{image}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quantity = quantity + VALUES(quantity)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart_item WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND sku_id = #{skuId}
